description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, the nonstationary subsets form an ideal that omits the entire order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.nonstationary_ideal.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) :
  Order.IsIdeal (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.nonstationaryIdeal α) ∧
    Set.univ ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.nonstationaryIdeal α
